hebrewText: וְ/אַ֤ף הֲסִיתְ/ךָ֨ מִ/פִּי צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑י/הָ וְ/נַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְ/ךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן

tokens.bdb: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.kjv: also, [phrase] although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, [phrase] how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.enLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanation: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanationEn: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though

tokens.bdb: properly, to prick, i.e. (figuratively) stimulate; by implication, to seduce
tokens.kjv: entice, move, persuade, provoke, remove, set on, stir up, take away.

tokens.bdb: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
tokens.kjv: accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), [idiom] eat, edge, end, entry, [phrase] file, hole, [idiom] in, mind, mouth, part, portion, [idiom] (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, [idiom] spoken, talk, tenor, [idiom] to, [phrase] two-edged, wish, word.

tokens.bdb: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
tokens.kjv: adversary, afflicted(-tion), anguish, close, distress, enemy, flint, foe, narrow, small, sorrow, strait, tribulation, trouble.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.

tokens.bdb: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.
tokens.kjv: as, beneath, [idiom] flat, in(-stead), (same) place (where...is), room, for...sake, stead of, under, [idiom] unto, [idiom] when...was mine, whereas, (where-) fore, with.

tokens.bdb: a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness
tokens.kjv: lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.

tokens.bdb: a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal
to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: accomplish, confirm, [phrase] consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, [idiom] draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-) flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-) full, [phrase] have wholly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to fill or  be full of
tokens.enLiteralWord: to fill or  be full of
tokens.explanation: to fill or  be full of
tokens.explanationEn: to fill or  be full of

tokens.bdb: the fat; abstractly fatness, i.e. (figuratively) abundance; specifically the (fatty) ashes of sacrifices
